title: Verify the Fence
description: Three checks that prove the container's boundaries hold, each written to fail loudly when the fence is working.

steps.description: The first check mounts the notes vault read-only and tries to touch a file in it. The comment says it should print Read-only file system, and the command echoes `BLOCKED-as-expected` when the write fails.
The second check runs with `--network none` and tries to resolve `api.anthropic.com`. The comment says it should fail, and the command echoes `NO-NETWORK-as-expected`.
The third check runs `mount` and greps for `/work`. The comment says it should show only `/work` as a writable bind mount. The page says to test the flags rather than take them on faith.
